summary: Renamed billingUrl->billingEndpoint (same value) in libs/shared-contracts and all users (billing, core-shell, and reports, which also referenced it) in one monorepo PR #1; CI and CD green. Assumptions: shared-contracts lives in the monorepo and is inlined at build, so there is no registry release/version bump. libs-platform-kit has no billingUrl reference and does not depend on shared-contracts, so no change/release there. Billing's platform-kit dependency is unrelated and unchanged.
